what: Proposed TSV reader loses empty middle fields
scenario_or_breakage: Rows like skills/design/SKILL.md<TAB>orchestrator-inline<TAB>4<TAB><TAB>2b,3b,4,5 are parsed by Bash read with tab as IFS whitespace, so 2b,3b,4,5 shifts into prompt_kind and step_markers is empty; the new B5 placement check is silently disabled
suggested_fix: Parse TSV with awk FS="\t" or translate tabs to a non-whitespace delimiter before read so empty fields are preserved in both lint and test consumers

what: Plan only replaces the dollar skip branch but leaves quote parsing and dollar detection incompatible with escaped double-quote literals
scenario_or_breakage: The current literal_end=index(rest, quote) stops at escaped quotes, so fixtures like say \"hi\" and the real --round-num \"\${STEP3_REVIEW_ROUND_NUM...}\" pin still SKIP; additionally rescanning the unescaped payload for $ would reject intended escaped-dollar literals
suggested_fix: Replace closing-quote detection with an escape-aware scan for double-quoted literals, and detect bare unescaped dollars on the original literal before converting \$ to $
